answer.evidence: Tx power fell ~4dB below spec while Rx fell by same amount (link loss stable ~11.2dB vs 10.93 commissioning). Bias ramped 45 to ~71mA then clamped while Tx kept falling = laser end-of-life, APC saturated. OTDR both directions shows no break/bend, splices <=0.25dB, connectors ~0.28dB; SC-06 -0.6/+0.76dB pair averages 0.08dB normal G.652/G.655 gainer. BER rises only as Rx nears sensitivity. Send equipped crew to Site A to replace A-TX.
